name: InMotion Hosting
tagline: cPanel shared hosting with a 90-day money-back guarantee and free site migrations
description: InMotion Hosting is a US-based web host offering cPanel-based shared, WordPress, VPS and dedicated hosting, known for a long 90-day money-back guarantee and free professional site migrations.
about: InMotion Hosting's shared hosting comes in four tiers: Core (1 website, 100GB SSD storage), Launch (2 websites, unlimited NVMe SSD storage), Power (10 websites, unlimited NVMe SSD storage) and Pro (40 websites, unlimited NVMe SSD storage). All four run on the industry-standard cPanel control panel and include free SSL, and a free domain credit on 12-36 month terms.

InMotion's lowest advertised prices apply only to longer signup terms and jump sharply at renewal — Launch runs roughly $4.99/month to start but renews around $13.99/month, Power around $17.99/month, and Pro around $24.99/month once the introductory term ends. Confirm the exact current promo and renewal rate on InMotion's own pricing page before checkout, since it changes periodically and varies by term length.
policies: InMotion Hosting backs shared hosting plans with a 90-day money-back guarantee — longer than the 30-day window most competitors offer.

faqs.q: How long is InMotion Hosting's money-back guarantee?
faqs.a: 90 days on shared hosting plans, which is notably longer than the 30-day window offered by most other budget hosts.

faqs.q: Does InMotion Hosting offer free website migration?
faqs.a: Yes — InMotion's migration team will transfer files, databases and email accounts from your current host at no charge on shared, WordPress and VPS plans, typically for up to a handful of sites depending on plan.
InMotion Hosting's introductory pricing starts from $4.99/month. Check the pricing page for renewal rates, since the lowest advertised price usually applies only to the first term.

faqs.q: Does InMotion Hosting include a free domain?
faqs.a: Yes, InMotion Hosting's plans include a free domain registration for the first year. It reverts to the standard renewal price after that.

faqs.q: Does InMotion Hosting include a free SSL certificate?
faqs.a: Yes — every InMotion Hosting plan includes a free SSL certificate so your site is secured over HTTPS from day one.

faqs.q: Do I need a promo code to get InMotion Hosting's best price?
faqs.a: Not always — some InMotion Hosting deals apply automatically at checkout, while others require pasting a revealed code into the promo/coupon field before you pay. Check each listing above for details.

faqs.q: How do I get started with InMotion Hosting?
faqs.a: Pick a plan that fits your needs on InMotion Hosting's website, complete checkout, and your account is usually ready within minutes.

faqs.q: Is InMotion Hosting good value for hosting?
faqs.a: InMotion Hosting is one of the more popular hosting providers — compare its plans and any current deal above against your specific needs before committing.

faqs.q: Can I cancel my InMotion Hosting plan anytime?
faqs.a: Most InMotion Hosting plans can be cancelled from your account dashboard; check InMotion Hosting's own terms for any minimum-term or refund conditions that apply to your plan.
